component.name: ToolTip
component.ToolTipText: Click on a weed, then choose the trash to throw it away.

component.name: ToolTip
component.ToolTipText: Click on your bag to open it. Choose the daisy seed in your bag, then select a place to plant it in the garden.

component.name: ToolTip
component.ToolTipText: Click on the planted seed, then select the watering can to water it.

component.name: ToolTip
component.ToolTipText: Click on the plant, then choose Take.

component.name: ToolTip
component.ToolTipText: Click on the bridge, then choose the mortar to use it on it.

component.name: ToolTip
component.ToolTipText: Click on the key, then click on the option to pick it up to set it in your bag.
